description: Canonical structural relationship model for BTE knowledge.

relationships.name: contains
relationships.semantics: Structural ownership of child objects within a parent container.

relationships.name: references
relationships.semantics: Non-owning citation to another knowledge object or document.

relationships.name: depends_on
relationships.semantics: Load-time or evaluation-time prerequisite. Cycles are prohibited unless explicitly allowed.

relationships.name: extends
relationships.semantics: Additive specialization that preserves the base identity.

relationships.name: inherits
relationships.semantics: Semantic inheritance of attributes/constraints from a more general concept.

relationships.name: overrides
relationships.semantics: Deterministic replacement under the override model.

relationships.name: conflicts_with
relationships.semantics: Mutual exclusion or priority contest resolved by priority/override rules.

relationships.name: requires
relationships.semantics: Hard prerequisite that must be satisfied for validity.

relationships.name: generated_from
relationships.semantics: Traceable derivation from upstream knowledge or analysis outputs.
